# 1 Samuel Chapter 28 -- The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 166v-167r | **Source Image:** 1SA_028_page_001.jpg, 1SA_028_page_002.jpg

---

**28:1** And-it-was in-the-days the-those, and-gathered [the]-Pelishtim (Philistines) their-camps for-war, to-fight against-Yisra'el (Israel). And-said Akhish (Achish) to David, "Know, yes-know, that with-me you-shall-go-out in-the-camp, you and-your-men."

**28:2** And-said David to Akhish (Achish), "Therefore you shall-know what your-servant will-do." And-said Akhish (Achish) to David, "Therefore [as]-guardian of-my-head I-will-set-you all the-days."

**28:3** And-Shemu'el (Samuel) had-died, and-mourned for-him all Yisra'el (Israel), and-they-buried him in-Ramah (the-height), and-in-his-city. And-Sha'ul (Saul) had-removed the-mediums and-the-spiritists from-the-land.

**28:4** And-gathered [the]-Pelishtim (Philistines), and-they-came and-they-encamped in-Shunem. And-gathered Sha'ul (Saul) all Yisra'el (Israel), and-they-encamped in-the-Gilboa (Gilboa).

**28:5** And-saw Sha'ul (Saul) the-camp of-[the]-Pelishtim (Philistines), and-he-feared, and-trembled his-heart greatly.

**28:6** And-inquired Sha'ul (Saul) of-YHWH, and-not answered-him YHWH, neither by-dreams, nor by-the-Urim, nor by-the-prophets.

**28:7** And-said Sha'ul (Saul) to-his-servants, "Seek for-me a-woman, a-mistress of-[a]-'ov (medium/necromancer), and-I-will-go to-her and-I-will-inquire through-her." And-said his-servants to-him, "Behold, a-woman, a-mistress of-[an]-'ov (medium), in-Ein-Dor (En-dor)."

**28:8** And-disguised-himself Sha'ul (Saul), and-he-put-on garments of-other-[ones], and-he-went, he and-two men with-him, and-they-came to the-woman [by]-night. And-he-said, "Divine, please, for-me by-the-'ov (medium), and-bring-up for-me [the one] whom I-shall-say to-you."

**28:9** And-said the-woman to-him, "Behold, you know what Sha'ul (Saul) has-done, that he-has-cut-off the-mediums and-the-spiritists from-the-land. And-why [are] you laying-a-snare for-my-life, to-cause-me-to-die?"

**28:10** And-swore to-her Sha'ul (Saul) by-YHWH, saying, "[As]-lives YHWH, if punishment shall-befall you in-this matter."

**28:11** And-said the-woman, "Whom shall-I-bring-up for-you?" And-he-said, "Shemu'el (Samuel) -- bring-him-up for-me."

**28:12** And-saw the-woman Shemu'el (Samuel), and-she-cried-out with-a-great voice, and-said the-woman to Sha'ul (Saul), saying, "Why have-you-deceived me? And-you [are] Sha'ul (Saul)!"

**28:13** And-said to-her the-king, "Do-not-fear. For what do-you-see?" And-said the-woman to Sha'ul (Saul), "Elohim (a-divine-being) I-see coming-up from-the-earth."

**28:14** And-he-said to-her, "What [is] his-form?" And-she-said, "A-man, old, [is]-coming-up, and-he [is]-wrapped in-a-robe." And-knew Sha'ul (Saul) that [it was] Shemu'el (Samuel), and-he-bowed [with his]-face to-the-ground, and-he-prostrated-himself.

**28:15** And-said Shemu'el (Samuel) to Sha'ul (Saul), "Why have-you-disturbed me, to-bring-me-up?" And-said Sha'ul (Saul), "I-am-in-great-distress, and-[the]-Pelishtim (Philistines) [are]-fighting against-me, and-God has-turned-away from-upon me, and-He-does-not-answer me again, neither by-[the]-hand of-the-prophets nor by-dreams. And-I-call to-you, to-make-known to-me what I-shall-do."

**28:16** And-said Shemu'el (Samuel), "And-why do-you-ask me, and-YHWH has-turned-away from-upon you and-has-become your-adversary?

**28:17** And-has-done YHWH to-him as-He-spoke by-my-hand, and-has-torn YHWH the-kingdom from-your-hand, and-has-given it to-your-neighbor, to-David.

**28:18** Because you-did-not-obey [the]-voice of-YHWH, and-you-did-not-execute the-burning of-His-anger against-Amaleq (Amalek), therefore this thing has-done YHWH to-you this day.

**28:19** And-will-give YHWH also Yisra'el (Israel) with-you into-[the]-hand of-[the]-Pelishtim (Philistines). And-tomorrow, you and-your-sons [will be] with-me. Also the-camp of-Yisra'el (Israel) will-give YHWH into-[the]-hand of-[the]-Pelishtim (Philistines)."

**28:20** And-hastened Sha'ul (Saul), and-he-fell [with the]-fullness of-his-stature to-the-ground, and-he-feared greatly from-[the]-words of-Shemu'el (Samuel). Also strength there-was-none in-him, for he-had-not-eaten bread all the-day and-all the-night.

**28:21** And-came the-woman to Sha'ul (Saul), and-she-saw that he-was-terrified greatly, and-she-said to-him, "Behold, has-listened your-maidservant to-your-voice, and-I-put my-life in-my-hand, and-I-listened to your-words which you-spoke to-me.

**28:22** And-now, listen, please, also you to-[the]-voice of-your-maidservant, and-let-me-set before-you a-morsel of-bread, and-eat, and-there-will-be in-you strength when you-go on-[the]-way."

**28:23** And-he-refused, and-he-said, "I-will-not eat." And-pressed on-him his-servants, and-also the-woman, and-he-listened to-their-voice. And-he-arose from-the-ground, and-he-sat upon the-bed.

**28:24** And-to-the-woman [was] a-calf, a-fattened-one, in-the-house, and-she-hurried and-she-slaughtered it, and-she-took flour, and-she-kneaded, and-she-baked it [into]-unleavened-bread.

**28:25** And-she-brought-near before Sha'ul (Saul) and-before his-servants, and-they-ate. And-they-arose, and-they-went in-the-night the-that.

---

## EMET's Textual Notes

1. **28:1** -- יָדֹעַ תֵּדַע (know, yes-know): Infinitive absolute + imperfect. Akhish pressures David to commit to fighting against Israel, setting up the crisis resolved in chapter 29.
2. **28:3** -- This verse serves as a narrative flashback (pluperfect), establishing two critical facts: Shemu'el's death and Sha'ul's own ban on necromancy. The irony of Sha'ul seeking what he himself outlawed pervades the chapter.
3. **28:6** -- The three legitimate means of divine inquiry -- חֲלֹמוֹת (dreams), אוּרִים (Urim), נְבִיאִים (prophets) -- are all closed to Sha'ul. The Urim reference implies the priestly ephod, which Sha'ul no longer has access to since Evyatar (Abiathar) fled to David (23:6).
4. **28:7** -- אֵשֶׁת בַּעֲלַת־אוֹב (a-woman, a-mistress of-[an]-'ov): The אוֹב refers to either the spirit of the dead or the pit/container from which the spirit speaks. The term is consistently condemned in Torah (Lev 19:31, 20:6, 27; Deut 18:11).
5. **28:13** -- אֱלֹהִים (elohim): Here used in its broader sense of "a divine/supernatural being," not specifically "God." The woman sees a figure ascending from the underworld (She'ol).
6. **28:14** -- מְעִיל (robe): The same garment-word used for Shemu'el's prophetic robe that was torn (15:27), creating a powerful literary echo. Sha'ul recognizes Shemu'el by this distinctive feature.
7. **28:16** -- וַיְהִי עָרֶךָ (and-has-become your-adversary): The Leningrad Codex reads עָרֶךָ from the root ער/עור meaning "adversary." The Qere tradition in some manuscripts suggests צָרֶךָ. The Ketiv reading preserved in the Leningrad text is maintained in this translation.
8. **28:19** -- עִמָּדִי (with-me): Shemu'el's statement "you and your sons will be with me" -- i.e., in She'ol, among the dead. This is the most explicit death oracle in the Former Prophets.
9. **28:24** -- עֻגוֹת מַצּוֹת (unleavened-bread): The woman bakes מַצּוֹת not for ritual reasons but because unleavened bread is faster to prepare, underscoring the urgency of the scene.

-- EMET
